researchEvidence.primaryStudy: G2-02 Search Reliability / Decision Robustness Study 1

mechanism.name: final nominal root-best-flip-triggered two-move depth-plus-one full-window confirmation
mechanism.lifetime: candidate state exists only within one analyzeMove call

runtimeTrigger.condition: deterministic selected root move key at final nominal completed depth d differs from the deterministic selected root move key at completed depth d-1
notTriggeredFor: nominal timeout before effective max depth
final two completed-depth move keys equal

confirmationSearch.rootCandidates: exactly the distinct previous-depth best move and final nominal-depth best move
confirmationSearch.confirmationDepth: d+1 root plies; evaluate each selected root child with remaining depth d at ply=1
confirmationSearch.evaluator: same evaluator instance as nominal search
confirmationSearch.deadline: same existing analyzeMove deadline; no added milliseconds
confirmationSearch.searchContext: reuse the same per-analyzeMove enhanced-search TT, killers, history, evaluator and counters; no new persistent state
confirmationSearch.incompleteOrTimeoutAction: return the frozen nominal completed-depth move; do not use a one-sided confirmation result
confirmationSearch.completedBothCandidatesSelection: choose higher full-window root-player score; on exact score tie retain the final nominal-depth move
confirmationSearch.completedDepthStat: retain nominal full-root completed depth d because only two moves, not the complete root set, were searched at d+1
confirmationSearch.rootScoreStatOnCompletedConfirmation: set to the selected confirmation candidate score and expose nominal score separately in candidate diagnostics

requiredExactEquality: all pre-existing stats fields and values

runtimeEligibleTarget.definition: frozen baseline hard/enhanced/bao D2 and D3 both complete and deterministic selected move keys differ
runtimeEligibleTarget.selection: outcome/value/consequence-blind deterministic hash ranking from the frozen global development root universe, with phase balance as target and deterministic fallback fill
runtimeEligibleTarget.insufficientDevelopmentSupportAction: DEVELOPMENT-NON-ESTIMABLE-HOLD; no replacement source block after inspection

negativeControl.definition: frozen baseline D2 and D3 deterministic selected move keys equal
negativeControl.selection: deterministic hash rank, phase balance target
negativeControl.purpose: trigger-zero and feature-on search-semantic no-op control
